quiz.title: histoire des arts : œuvres, artistes, mouvements artistiques
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
The Impressionist movement indeed emphasized the effects of light and color in art.
'David' is a famous sculpture created by Michelangelo.
Pablo Picasso was indeed a leading figure in the Cubist art movement, which he co-founded with Georges Braque.
'The Last Supper' is a famous painting created by Leonardo da Vinci.
Claude Monet was indeed known for his landscape paintings, particularly those depicting gardens and water lilies.
Surrealism, Realism, and Abstract Expressionism are all recognized art movements in the history of art.
'The Scream' is indeed a famous painting created by the Norwegian artist Edvard Munch.
